content.title: Robot Street Reversal | Theft, Self-Fall and Comic Retaliation
content.summary: A florist recovers a parcel after a courier's self-caused bicycle fall. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One fixed witness view shows the violation before any retaliation. + The exact stolen object remains visible through approach, flight, fall and recovery. + The violator's own movement causes the fall; the witness does not cause the injury. + Recovery of the object precedes the bounded comic retaliation. + The terminal state separates recovered owner, stopped violator and persistent aftermath.
quick_start.recommended_input: From one high apartment-window view, show an adult bicycle courier quietly taking a red parcel from an adult florist's cart. A loose delivery strap catches the rear wheel, causing one bounded low-speed fall; the parcel slides to the curb intact. The florist exits with the parcel while the embarrassed courier sits up beside the disabled bicycle.
required_anchors: One fixed witness view shows the violation before any retaliation.
The exact stolen object remains visible through approach, flight, fall and recovery.
Recovery of the object precedes the bounded comic retaliation.
The terminal state separates recovered owner, stopped violator and persistent aftermath.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.

invariants.rule: One fixed witness view shows the violation before any retaliation.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One fixed witness view shows the violation before any retaliation."

invariants.rule: The exact stolen object remains visible through approach, flight, fall and recovery.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "The exact stolen object remains visible through approach, flight, fall and recovery."

invariants.rule: The violator's own movement causes the fall; the witness does not cause the injury.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "The violator's own movement causes the fall; the witness does not cause the injury."

invariants.rule: Recovery of the object precedes the bounded comic retaliation.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Recovery of the object precedes the bounded comic retaliation."

invariants.rule: The terminal state separates recovered owner, stopped violator and persistent aftermath.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The terminal state separates recovered owner, stopped violator and persistent aftermath."
